essence: The main ritual must be preceded by auspicious-day declaration, sprinkling, and elemental purification
The sacrificer should then recite the mantra named Rudragayatri
The sacrificer should be situated in the middle of the eastern place facing the western row
The ritual should be accompanied by Vedic instruments and endowed with dance and song
The mounting of the balance should then be done by that person's own body
